headline: Vital Chemtech appoints M/s. SCS & Co. LLP as secretarial auditor
hook: New secretarial auditor for the upcoming fiscal year
summary: Vital Chemtech Limited has informed the stock exchange about the appointment of M/s. SCS & Co. LLP as its secretarial auditor. The appointment becomes effective from April 1, 2025. Secretarial auditors ensure compliance with corporate laws and regulatory requirements. This is a routine governance filing for the listed chemical company.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on share price

headline: Vital Chemtech discloses AGM voting results
summary: Vital Chemtech Limited has submitted the official voting results from its Annual General Meeting held on September 28, 2026. The exchange filing provides formal compliance documentation for resolutions passed by shareholders. This routine corporate filing has no direct impact on the company's financial fundamentals. Indian retail investors holding the stock can note the compliance completion without expecting market movement.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with zero impact on stock price.
